compute_location_error: compute the 2D location error between predicted and ground truth UV coordinates given pixels per meter
compute_angle_error: compute the angular error between predicted and ground truth yaw angles in degrees
track_location_2d_recall: track the 2D location recall metric by computing how often errors fall below a threshold
track_angle_recall: track the angle recall metric by computing how often yaw errors fall below a threshold
compute_lateral_longitudinal_error: compute lateral and longitudinal error by rotating UV displacement into yaw-aligned coordinates
